## What's new

Threadnote 5.2.0-beta.5 makes Context Brief citation validation faster on large local repositories while improving integration imports and giving Manager users clearer control over graph scope.

- Context Brief now overlaps independent repository identity and worktree observations while preserving the same safety checks, improving large-corpus citation validation latency.
- Manager lets you select the graph scope used for project Index and Reindex actions, with stale and foreign selections rejected before work begins.
- Superhuman and Pocket imports now preserve each source page or recording as one complete, readable resource; resync removes obsolete legacy fragments.
- Adding GitHub, Linear, Pocket, or Superhuman connections can reuse an available saved credential safely, while each local connection keeps an independent owner-only copy.
- Manager hides internal synchronization receipts and empty sync-only folders from the resource tree.

[Full changelog since 5.2.0-beta.4](https://github.com/threadnote/threadnote/compare/v5.2.0-beta.4...v5.2.0-beta.5)
